notes: Hand-labelled real plans. Coordinates are native image pixels. 'rooms' are points inside each room; rooms sharing a 'group' are one open-plan area and may legitimately be one space. 'openings' (where present) use the same format as test_floorplan_openings.json. Plans live outside the repository: by default '../Test Cases' next to the project (override with FLOORPLAN_REAL_PLANS). 9.png was removed from this set at the user's request and must not be used as a target case. 'printed' is the room name as printed on the drawing (null: the drawing prints no name for that room); semantic room-name metrics use only rooms with a printed name. N.1 benchmark additions: 'openings' for 5.jpeg, 8.png, 11.png, 14.png, 16.png, 19.jpg (kind 'opening' = real but ambiguous opening, e.g. passage or glazed door; it is not counted against door/window precision). 'nonstructural' are points on furniture/fixtures/markers that must not be wall; 'protected' are points on short real structural pieces (piers, stubs, mullions) that must stay wall. These were labelled by hand while viewing engine overlays (engine-assisted), so engine-invisible openings may be under-represented; see per-plan 'gt_notes'. 'physical' (2026-10-06): sharper open-space ground truth from the raw drawings - must_share sets must be one physical space; may_share sets may be one or several; any other two rooms in one space is a false merge.
